  • Constructor Details

    • Metadata

      public Metadata(String id, String areaName, String pointName, ProcessBoundaryConstraintEvidence.Kind kind, ProcessBoundaryConstraintEvidence.FlowDirection flowDirection, NetworkDecisionVariable.RateBasis rateBasis, String provenance, double confidence, String effectiveFrom, String effectiveTo, ProcessBoundaryConstraintEvidence.ApplicabilityStatus applicabilityStatus, String observableName, String method, String referenceJson, int periodIndex)
      Creates complete immutable boundary metadata.
      Parameters:
      id - stable caller-owned identifier
      areaName - process-model area name
      pointName - named boundary point
      kind - boundary role
      flowDirection - positive-flow direction
      rateBasis - rate basis, or NONE for non-flow constraints
      provenance - source of the limit or nomination
      confidence - confidence in [0, 1], or NaN when not quantified
      effectiveFrom - inclusive effective-period label, or null
      effectiveTo - inclusive effective-period label, or null
      applicabilityStatus - validity assessment for this evaluation context
      observableName - measured attribute or metric key, or null
      method - calculation, test, or standard name, or null
      referenceJson - serialized reference conditions, or null
      periodIndex - zero-based nomination period, or -1 when not applicable
